provenance: Original concise public-documentation notes; no upstream implementation, tests or examples inspected or copied; no execution parity claim
publicBehavior: CPD-OFF and CPD-ON in comments delimit omitted duplication regions in documented language families
Legacy Java annotation suppression is a separate mechanism

nativePolicy.optIn: clones.suppressionComments must be true; explicit false preserves the previous method and report
nativePolicy.markers: Case-sensitive words in actual parser/reader comments, never string/argument literals
nativePolicy.boundaries: Retained segments cannot match across omitted regions; all other rules and syntax validation inspect original source
nativePolicy.audit: Sorted UTF-16 ranges from end of OFF to start of ON in JSON and SARIF; text count; no source text
nativePolicy.refusals: Unmatched ON, nested OFF, unterminated OFF and more than 10,000 total markers
nativePolicy.work: Suppressed tokens still consume existing token/source/parser budgets; CMake comment/token entries share its 100,000-entry limit
nativePolicy.limits: Original policy across thirteen language modes; no legacy Java annotations, full lexer equivalence or competitor parity claim
